en.summary: ThinkMarkets is a multi-asset CFD broker founded in 2010 with an FCA-authorised UK entity and MT4, MT5 and its own ThinkTrader platform.
pros: TF Global Markets (UK) Limited is shown as FCA-authorised on the FCA register (checked 2026-11-03)
Several regulated entities (UK, Australia, Cyprus, South Africa) plus an offshore one
Standard account spreads from 0.4 pips; ThinkZero raw spreads from 0.0
MT4, MT5 and the proprietary ThinkTrader platform
cons: Global clients may be onboarded to the Seychelles entity, which is offshore
Minimum deposit figures differ between ThinkMarkets pages and regions
Leverage varies by region (500:1 on the global page, 30:1 for Australia)
Its websites block automated access, so some details could only be read via search results
en.body:
## Regulation and safety

ThinkMarkets operates through several entities. The FCA firm checker shows TF Global Markets (UK) Limited (FRN 629628) as authorised, since 23 January 2015 (checked 2026-11-03). The broker's pages also name TF Global Markets (Aust) Limited (ASIC), CySEC and FSCA licensed entities, and TF Global Markets Int Limited (Seychelles FSA, SD060). Those were not confirmed on their registers in this run, and the AFSL number is given inconsistently across its pages, so we do not quote it. Which entity holds your account depends on your country.

## Trading conditions

The broker traces its origins to ThinkForex in 2010. The Standard account advertises spreads from 0.4 pips with no commission, while ThinkZero offers raw spreads from 0.0 plus commission. Minimum deposits are shown differently across ThinkMarkets pages (between $0 and $500 depending on account and region), so check your regional entity. Maximum leverage is region-dependent, for example 500:1 on the global Standard page versus 30:1 for Australia.

## Platforms

MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5 and the proprietary ThinkTrader platform.

## Who is it for?

Traders who want a multi-regulated broker with both commission-free and raw-spread accounts. Confirm the entity and its protections before depositing.

CFD trading carries a high risk of losing money.

ja.body:
## 規制と安全性

ThinkMarketsは複数の法人で運営されています。FCAのファームチェッカーではTF Global Markets (UK) Limited（FRN 629628）が2015年1月23日付で認可済みと確認しました（2026-11-03）。同社ページにはTF Global Markets (Aust) Limited（ASIC）、CySEC・FSCA認可の法人、TF Global Markets Int Limited（セーシェルFSA、SD060）も記載されていますが、今回各登録簿では確認しておらず、AFSL番号は同社ページ間で表記が一致しないため掲載しません。口座の法人は居住国によって決まります。

## 取引条件

2010年のThinkForexに起源を持ちます。スタンダード口座は手数料無料でスプレッド0.4pipsから、ThinkZeroはRawスプレッド0.0から（手数料別）。最低入金額はページ・地域により0〜500ドルと表記が異なるため、地域法人でご確認ください。最大レバレッジも地域により異なり、グローバルのスタンダードは500倍、豪州は30倍です。

## プラットフォーム

MT4、MT5、独自のThinkTraderに対応します。

## どんな人に向いているか

手数料無料口座とRawスプレッド口座を選べる、複数規制のブローカーを求める方に向きます。入金前に口座法人と保護内容をご確認ください。

CFD取引は損失リスクが高い取引です。
